1221973.title: Untitled Ocean's Prequel

1268053.title: Winnie the Pooh: Blood and Honey 3

1300501.trailerName: Patriot | Official Trailer | Mammootty | Mohanlal | Tamil ZEE5 | Premieres 5th June 2026

1319125.trailerName: FILM KUYANK | SARANJANA The Prequel | Official Trailer | 29 Januari 2026 Di Bioskop

1356053.title: Proclivitas
1356053.overview: Clare is an addict in recovery when her mother’s sudden death turns her carefully measured world upside down. Returning to her hometown, she reconnects with teenage sweetheart Jerry. He’s the one Clare could never stop thinking about. It’s been fifteen years since a tragic accident tore them apart. Now they have a second chance at happiness. But as their love returns, so does the ghosts of the past, threatening Clare’s sobriety and triggering a powerful demonic presence determined to control her.

1363285.title: Brimstone Terrace
1363285.overview: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

1364629.title: A Girl Unknown
1364629.overview: A Chinese girl is passed between three families from the age of 6 to 18, receiving each time a new name and identity. As she searches for belonging and the possibility of love, she has to navigate between the weight of her past and the uncertainty of her future, until she finds her own way.

1377237.title: Runner
1377237.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

1392469.title: Cocktail 2
1392469.overview: After a decade together, Diya and Kunal's relationship is shaken when Ally, an old friend, re-enters their lives. What begins as a plan between two women spirals into chaos, triggering hilarious, emotional rollercoaster none of them saw coming.

1397909.title: Honeyjoon
1397909.overview: Persian-Kurdish Lela and her American daughter June take a trip to the romantic Azores after a recent loss, both with polar opposite views about why they’re there, how to grieve, and the size of June’s tiny bikini. Amidst honeymooners, the Woman, Life, Freedom movement and their hot, philosophical tour guide, João, the pair find each other… coming back to life.

1399253.title: Our Secret
1399253.overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

1405205.title: The Riverbank
1405205.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

1418901.title: Mother's Pride
1418901.overview: A comedy about a failing pub, a divided community and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

1422101.title: Glorious Summer
1422101.overview: Hot summer, Renaissance palace. Three women remain in a carefree state of limbo, and an enigmatic system fulfills all their life needs – it provides food, entertainment and development. There is one condition – they are not allowed to cross the wall that surrounds their place. From under the idyllic picture, the other, darker side of the new reality quickly shines through.

1423253.title: Korean Kanakaraju
1423253.overview: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

1427157.title: My Lord
1427157.overview: A man and his wife battle bureaucracy after being wrongly declared dead, while he confronts a kidney trafficking ring connected to corrupt politicians that destroyed his life.

1441301.title: Saptadingar Guptodhon
1441301.overview: Subarna Sen, along with Abir and Jhinuk, go on a dangerous treasure hunt in the Sundarbans. The trio seeks the legendary treasure of Raja Pratapaditya, facing increased risks in a new adventure that blends history, folklore, and suspense
1441301.trailerName: Saptadingar Guptodhon (সপ্তডিঙার গুপ্তধন) | Official Trailer | Abir | Arjun | Ishaa | Dhrubo B | SVF

1444309.title: Sky to Soil
1444309.overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

1454741.title: The Confession

1462229.title: Pegasus 3
1462229.overview: Bearing the glory of being the 'King of Bayanbulak', Zhang Chi once again embarks on his racing journey, aiming not only to win the race but also to achieve something beyond the competition itself.

1465557.title: Our Hero, Balthazar
1465557.overview: Eager to impress his activist crush, a wealthy New York teenager follows an online connection to Texas, where he's convinced he can stop an act of extreme violence.

1465685.title: The Devil Within
1465685.overview: Spain, 1980s. Philippe is a ten-year-old French boy traveling with his very pregnant mother, Marie, and his father, Tomas, whose plan is to take them home to the village where he grew up and introduce the boy to his Spanish roots. But an unfortunate breakdown leads the family to a scrapyard on the outskirts of a deserted inland town, where they come upon its owners, Alicia and Miguel.

1474133.title: The Tao Exorcist
1474133.overview: Late at night, a father throws his children into a kiln, muttering, “They’re no longer ours.” Their screams fade into the flames. Young exorcist Xiao Tuo suspects his classmate Nianqi is possessed, uncovering her stepfather Zhen-Kai’s use of dark rituals. As her siblings show disturbing behavior, Zhen-Kai plans a deadly purge. Xiao Tuo links the evil spirit to his own injured father, and together with Nianqi, uncovers a horrifying truth tied to a missing persons case from fifteen years ago.

1484181.title: The Smell of Apples
1484181.overview: In the insulated bubble of white Apartheid South Africa, Marnus, a sheltered 11-year old boy accuses the grandson of his family’s domestic worker of steeling his fishing rod. A brutal chain of events is set in motion, shattering the illusion of his family’s wholesome facade.

1487317.title: Therapy Done Right
1487317.overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

1492501.title: Being Towards Death
1492501.overview: After a failed suicide attempt, Zhang Xiaobing (Jiang Long) is sent to Ward 10 — a ward for the critically ill, but strangely full of joy. Among patients clinging to life, a man who wanted to die discovers the courage to live.

1496021.title: The making of "The Kaptain: The story of Francesco Silvestre"
1496021.overview: The story behind the production of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre" (2025)

1502997.title: Wendehorn
1502997.overview: Tara enters forbidden territory trying to find the wendehorn

1509717.title: Flying Colors
1509717.overview: Belén, a 17-year-old who uses a wheelchair, feels she is being left behind as her friends plan their futures outside of school. Her rebelliousness leads her to an adapted athletics club, where she meets Laura, a Paralympic athlete who inspires her to reconnect with her body and confidence. Belén will discover that growing up is not about following the path of others, but about building her own, even if in a different way.

1511829.title: The Nameless Ballad
1511829.overview: Death is a powerful muse. Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

1516501.title: Prathichaya
1516501.overview: After Kerala’s Chief Minister dies in a scandal engineered by a ruthless media tycoon, his son a brilliant tech entrepreneur enters the blood-soaked arena of politics to expose the conspiracy, vindicate his father, and turn technology against those who weaponized it

1517333.title: K-Pop: The Debut
1517333.overview: A young Korean-American woman defies her family's wishes to compete in a televised competition to find the next K-pop girl group.

1517461.overview: In an Andean village in Peru, in 1982, Tato, a 12-year-old boy is forced into exile when his family is threatened.

1528021.title: Panor 2
1528021.overview: After Panor renounces the power of the Three-Eyed God, her life is reset — her memory wiped clean. She begins a new chapter, living her dream of studying at a teacher's college, with Piak quietly watching over and helping her from afar.
1528021.trailerName: Full trailer for the movie Panor 2 | Official Trailer

1530389.title: Home Not Alone 3
1530389.overview: Masha encounters the insidious Nanny again. But now the villain has a new ally - the charming swindler Anton. At stake is the school graduation! Together with her friend Yegor, Masha must stop the criminals and save the most important evening of the year.

1533397.title: The Artist
1533397.overview: A young man addicted to sex sees a great opportunity to become a film critic.

1535189.title: Plastic Guns
1535189.overview: A standoff reveals unsettling truths for an old cowboy.

1537301.title: Dreamboi
1537301.overview: A trans woman becomes entranced by the voice of an underground audio porn star. Torn between fantasy and reality, she drifts through the neon haze of Quezon City on a journey of desire, pain, and self-discovery.

1545621.title: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
1545621.overview: The 29th Detective Conan film will center on Chihaya Hagiwara, a member of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police and the leader of its motorcycle division.

1550357.title: Titip Bunda di Surga-Mu
1550357.overview: Three siblings (Alya, Adam, and Azzam) desperate for money decide to rob their mother's savings. They consider it as taking the inheritance first. Their mother is devastated, and the siblings pretend to care by taking turns accompanying her. While they're together, a big secret is revealed, forcing them to decide whether to admit their mistakes before it's too late.
1550357.trailerName: Di Balik Sifat Kerasnya Tante Meriam Bellina | Official Trailer Titip Bunda di Surga-Mu

1554709.title: Racism In A*t
1554709.overview: When an organization that hunts prejudice in art finds its next target, silence is no longer an option.

1559189.title: BURN
1559189.overview: When runaway teen Ju-Ju is embraced by a tribe of misfit youths in Kabukicho, she finds belonging for the first time — until betrayal and despair twist her haven into a prison, and she's left with one way to take back control.

1559637.title: Dracula in Space
1559637.overview: When the deep‑space vessel Orpheus discovers a centuries‑old derelict drifting at the edge of a black hole, the crew retrieves a sealed sarcophagus from its ruins. Soon after, crew members begin to disappear. Something ancient has awakened in the void - Dracula himself, exiled to the stars and hungry after centuries of confinement.

1562901.title: Big Little Things
1562901.overview: A seemingly perfect middle-class Chinese family faces an unprecedented situation when Lei brings a man home on NYE to pretend to be her boyfriend. Her same-sex girlfriend's unexpected visit intertwined her with a real intimacy crisis.

1568597.title: Hélène Trésore Transnationale
1568597.overview: In this intimate portrait addressed directly to Hélène Hazera, filmmaker Judith Abitbol revisits a key figure of France’s countercultures from the late 1960s to the 1990s. A member of the Gazolines and the FHAR (Homosexual Front for Revolutionary Action), Hazera was a tireless LGBTQ activist who founded Act Up’s Trans and AIDS commissions—one of her proudest achievements. Her true victory, however, was becoming the first transgender journalist at a major national newspaper (Libération), and later a producer at Radio France and France TV. Through her story, Abitbol reconnects with the insurrectionary spirit and creative chaos of those decades—an era when French culture was shaken by radical imagination, humor, and defiance. The film celebrates these modern Antigones who dared to live their desires beyond the reach of any law.

1570517.title: Backyard Sports: The Animated Special
1570517.overview: It’s Opening Day at Steele Stadium. But team superstar Stephanie ‘Bubbles’ Morgan is in crisis. She’s lost her gotta-have-it, never-play-without-it lucky bubble gum! With just 30 minutes until game time, the Backyard kids embark on a wild mission to track it down and save their season.

1579093.title: Hamletmachine
1579093.overview: Hamlet and Ophelia reckon with their doomed narratives. Adapted from the 1977 East German Heiner Müller play of the same name.

1583381.title: Perla
1583381.overview: Vicente Espinel is a folk musician struggling to preserve tradition in a world increasingly dominated by reggaeton. His life changes when he crosses paths with Perla, a bold and magnetic urban artist. Their connection sparks a clash between heritage and innovation.

1590037.title: Burza
1590037.overview: A devout Polish woman living in a small Mexican town endures a suffocating religious routine under her husband’s control, along with the unsettling presence of a  mysterious entity dwelling in one of the rooms.

1590613.title: Cerita Lila
1590613.overview: Two twins named Lila and Lili. Both experienced tragic ends after alleged abuse by their own mother, Rahma. However, death does not immediately end their story. In another realm, Lila continues to search for her twin sister, Lili, who was separated from her. This search then leads Lila into a greater mystery that has been hidden. In addition to facing a deep sense of loss, Lila also tries to understand the reasons behind the tragedy that destroyed their lives. Meanwhile, mysterious figures begin to appear and reveal that there is a greater power deliberately hiding the truth.

1590677.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
1590677.overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.
1590677.trailerName: Putri, Stop Wandering Around - Teaser Trailer | November 5, 2026 in Theaters

1590933.title: You, Like a Star
1590933.overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

1591829.title: Annem Hakkında
1591829.overview: At a summer resort, a large family gathers to celebrate the fifth anniversary of Aysel's death and hold a Mawlid recitation. The gathering, which brings together the woman's son Caner, her ex-husband Muharrem, her brother Halil, her sister-in-law Nermin, and her sister Halime, sparks unexpected arguments and turns their relationship upside down.

1592021.title: Lost in Paradise
1592021.overview: When the founder of a high-end fashion company gets marooned on a "deserted" island with a chef, romance blossoms as they work together to survive.

1594901.title: Taboo Cocoon
1594901.overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

1599189.title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争

1599445.title: Between Brothers
1599445.overview: In this intimate family portrait, documentary filmmaker Tom Fassaert observes the relationship between his father Rob (72) and his older brother René (75). What begins as a tragicomic film about their unusual dynamic – one was a psychologist for many years, the other a psychiatric patient – turns into a moving search for their unknown roots.

1600149.title: Drax
1600149.overview: Drax, a centuries-old vampire hiding in plain sight, spends his nights painting and resisting the urge to feed. But when he meets Marcus, a magnetic young skater, the lines between hunger, desire, and connection begin to blur.

1600661.title: Velvet Fire
1600661.overview: Silvana, a young trans woman, faces the gradual collapse of her relationship while carrying a wound that shapes her present: the belief that she cannot be loved. Amid confusion, jealousy, and the urge to hold on to what is falling apart, she receives news that forces her to confront her family past. Along the way, Silvana must choose the life she wants to build and whether she can break free from the idea that she is destined for loneliness.

1603157.title: Fuck Mr Flanagan
1603157.overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

1604245.title: Will You Come Find Me?
1604245.overview: Ten-year-old Yu and his younger sister loved playing “The Countdown Game” with their grandfather, who could always find the hidden watch in seconds. After Grandpa’s sudden passing, u feels lost and is misunderstood as having taken the watch. As he searches for it with his sister, he is forced to confront the grief he has tried to avoid. A moment of honesty with his mother finally opens the door for Yu to release his long-held emotions and find the courage to face his sadness.

1610901.title: Aag Lagay Basti Mein
1610901.overview: Barkat is an honest, hard-working man struggling to make ends meet alongside his wife, Almaas, who has grown tired of their modest life. Working as cleaners, the couple decides to turn to petty crime in hopes of improving their financial situation. What begins as small, calculated risks soon spirals into something far bigger, drawing the couple into the world of seasoned criminals. As guns, chases, and escalating chaos enter their lives, Barkat and Almaas find their domestic relationship increasingly entangled with crime and danger. Blending dark comedy with crime drama, the story explores ambition, greed, and the unintended consequences of trying to take shortcuts to a better life
1610901.trailerName: Aag Lagay Basti Mein | Official Trailer | Fahad Mustafa & Mahira Khan | This Eid

1620821.title: Milly: Queen of Merengue
1620821.overview: Vibrant musical inspired by the unique life of Dominican singer Milly Quezada worldwide known as the Queen of Merengue who as precocious young girl is forced to leave her country to escape a city torn by the 1965 civil war, once in New York she'll struggle to find her place in the colorful streets of Washington Heights where the wave of Latino immigration was just beginning, her musical journey will place her amongst the few female figures of the Latin Boom in the seventies alongside Celia Cruz and La Lupe.
1620821.trailerName: Milly, Queen of Merengue - Trailer (Dominican Cinema)

1622357.title: The Male Gaze: Wild Youth
1622357.overview: Witness how human nature can reveal that there are forces within us that are either challenged by - or reflected in - the people and environments that surround us in these five short films from around the world that take a closer look at the gay experience.

1622485.title: Peculiar Green
1622485.overview: A middle-aged man with deity-like powers details the creation of his new world. A world characterized by a shade of green.

1623125.title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
1623125.overview: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.

1624853.title: Convince Me
1624853.overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

1626325.title: Le Ruban bleu
1626325.overview: In the backstage of a beauty pageant, excitement runs high. Amid bustling crew, anxious contestants, and invested families, the host guides us through the final moments before curtain-up. But beneath the pageant’s cheerful façade, a more complex world unfolds. Here, dreams and pressure collide, and… the outcome may not be what anyone expects.

1626645.title: A Shot at Art
1626645.overview: Every summer, seasoned volunteers and friends Helen (67) and Peggy (64) give their all for the prestigious festival Art at Sea. This year promises to be special, as they have been assigned to scan tickets at the Hangar.

1628117.title: Untitled Ataraxia Sequel
1628117.overview: Ever since the storm subsided and the aberrations it birthed withered into the ruins, the Impact Zone has been closely monitored - its horrors believed contained. But when strange infections begin appearing beyond the Impact Zone's borders, it becomes clear that the nightmare is far from over...

1630293.title: They Wait in Shadows
1630293.overview: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.

1630549.title: Stepmother
1630549.overview: A woman searching for love mistakes safety for home, and in doing so becomes entangled with a grieving daughter whose need for devotion turns survival into complicity.

1632981.title: Haciendo amigos
1632981.overview: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

1638741.title: Sgt. Haane
1638741.overview: This documentary-drama film follows Lance Sgt. Haane Manahi DCM of B Company, 28th Māori Battalion, a soldier of extraordinary courage, whose actions proved pivotal in the 1943 battle for the fortified summit of Takrouna, Tunisia.

1650389.title: Arborea
1650389.overview: In a near future, vegetation has mysteriously stopped reproducing.  A scientist monitors the sound frequencies of an oak tree, until one day she hears a new sound.

1650901.title: I'll Hold You Always
1650901.overview: Naya, a tough mother who lives her life with one main goal, ensuring that her son, Aksa, has a future far better than anything she has ever experienced.

1654677.title: Your Lips Never Left Mine
1654677.overview: A young woman is hired by a finance couple to tutor their son at their summer lake house, and finds herself increasingly enmeshed in the undisclosed darkness of their past.
1654677.trailerName: Your Lips Never Left Mine - Official Trailer

1660565.title: Wolpie of the Woods
1660565.overview: Driven by hunger through a forest of strange cryptids, a determined Wolpertinger discovers that it's a trap to only look out for himself because it keeps the creatures predictable. Seen from a new perspective, he learns that connection, not isolation, offers him the best chance of survival.

1661205.title: That They May Be One
1661205.overview: Uncovers a remarkable story of God’s providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges.
1661205.trailerName: That They May Be One - Official Trailer

1662293.title: The Little Mammoth
1662293.overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

1662997.title: Million Dollar Babies: The Big Business Behind Eel Trafficking
1662997.overview: Across rivers, national borders and black markets, this documentary delves into the billion-dollar world of glass eel smuggling. With exclusive access to key players and rare footage, the film reveals how the global appetite for eels is fuelling an ecological catastrophe.

1665429.title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
1665429.overview: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

1666901.title: Thick & Sweet 甜腻腻
1666901.overview: The uprooted, the American dreams, the thick and sweet sauce, and an empty dining hall—too much for one to face and survive. It is far easier to demolish a closed restaurant. Composed of cutouts, reenactments, found footage, and fragments of earlier films, the work attempts to rebuild personal and collective memory while reflecting on the immigrant experience through the Americanization of food.

1671701.title: Nar'sata: Sekutu Setan
1671701.overview: Balqis grew up in suffering and betrayal. Driven by revenge, she chose a dark path without realizing that every action has a price.
1671701.trailerName: NAR'SATA: SEKUTU SETAN | FINAL TRAILER | DI PAWAGAM 21 MEI 2026

1674517.title: Mario
1674517.overview: Ronald Reagan’s America sets the stage for Mario Cuomo, the son of Italian immigrants who rose to become Governor of New York and, in his defining 1984 DNC speech, offered a powerful vision of leadership rooted in compassion.

1674837.title: Insects – Hidden Heroes
1674837.overview: How did our world come into being? Beneath our feet lies a class of animals far more numerous than any other. Let us embark on a journey through time dating back 400 million years, and witness how scattered pieces fit together to form a complete whole. Insects – Hidden Heroes takes us into the microcosm with stunning visuals. Narrated by screen icon Katharina Thalbach, the film poses a question: Must it be humanity or nature?
